description: A React component (`TestFileView`) for rendering a detailed view of test files and their associated test case summaries. Includes UI elements like status icons, links, badges for images and videos, and project labels. It manages expandable/collapsible sections for test files and displays test details such as duration, location, and attachments.

methods.name: ImageDiffBadge
methods.description: A React component that checks test result attachments for image files with specific naming conventions and renders a badge link if such images are found.

methods.name: VideoBadge
methods.description: A React component that searches test results for a video attachment and renders a badge link if present.
